payload.hypothesis_validated: H4 (macOS Docker VM filesystem semantics) — with specific mechanism identified
payload.mechanism: Docker Desktop's com.apple.Virtualization.VirtualMachine.xpc process (Apple Hypervisor backing Docker on macOS) holds read-only file descriptors on `.git/HEAD.lock` (and other `.git/` contents — refs/heads/, refs/, objects/, .git/ directory) while git is performing atomic ref-update operations. Docker Desktop monitors the entire project root because the repo's docker-compose.yml bind-mounts multiple subdirectories (`./docs/agent-memory`, `./reports`, `./docs/data`, `./mcp.config.json`). The VM's VirtioFS/GRPCFUSE file-sharing layer scans parent directories of every bind-mounted path for change detection, opens new files (including transient lock files), and these open handles race git's atomic create+rename+unlink lock operations.

evidence.key_lsof_output: com.apple 51247 admin *631r REG 1,4 0 29067863 .git/HEAD.lock — and 5 other open fds on .git/, .git/refs/heads, .git/refs/, .git/objects/, .git/objects/6e/...
evidence.process_identification: PID 51247 = /System/Library/Frameworks/Virtualization.framework/Versions/A/XPCServices/com.apple.Virtualization.VirtualMachine.xpc/Contents/MacOS/com.apple.Virtualization.VirtualMachine — running 174:27 CPU time, definitely Docker Desktop's VM
evidence.concurrent_trigger: market-watcher cron commit b9056f34 fired during dev-team c57 merge gate retry — concurrent git activity from Claude cron schedule triggered the race

hypotheses_disposition.H1_rapid_git_commit_race: REJECTED — index.lock collision was the cron-vs-dev-team race symptom, but HEAD.lock recurrence even in single-agent sessions (c56 evidence) proves another process holds the lock
hypotheses_disposition.H2_hook_crash: ELIMINATED in c57 pre-PO probe — no commit hooks in `.git/hooks/` (only pre-push symlink); `commit.gpgsign` unset
hypotheses_disposition.H3_SDK_bash_wrapper: REJECTED — lsof shows Apple VM PID, not Claude Code SDK PID
hypotheses_disposition.H4_macOS_APFS_docker_VM: CONFIRMED with refined mechanism — not 'APFS coalesces unlinks' but rather 'Docker Desktop VM opens lock files via VirtioFS file-sharing during project root scan'

payload.ask:
Architect — update brief `docs/architecture-briefs/2026-05-12-headlock-and-worktree-root-cause.md` with confirmed root cause. Specify c58 permanent-fix proposal from these options:
  Option F1 (USER-ACTION): Add `.git/` to Docker Desktop file-sharing exclusions (System Settings → Resources → File Sharing → exclude path). Requires user dashboard action.
  Option F2 (CONFIG): Migrate bind mounts in `docker-compose.yml` to named volumes for paths that don't need host-side editing (`./reports`, `./docs/data`). Reduces VM scan surface. Keep `./docs/agent-memory` if cron agents need to write there from host.
  Option F3 (CONFIG): Move `.git/` out of Docker-watched tree via `git --git-dir=<external-path>` config. Major operational change.
  Option F4 (DEFENSIVE): Keep PREFLIGHT self-cure as permanent backstop + add lock-acquisition retry wrapper (M-A1 from brief). No upstream fix.
payload.current_state: Self-cure guard works symptomatically (cycles c52→c57 = 6 cycles of cure). NO functional impact, only operational friction (each cycle's PREFLIGHT removes the lock + WORK notification). Diagnostic instrumentation (c57 commit 749a0b02) now captures evidence on future occurrences.
